buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to

increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidders should read the terms and conditions of NIT document before floating the tender. Bidders must follow the terms and conditions of NI T document and as per the direction of the engineer in charge after the issuing of the work order. ATC 1. SECURITY DEPOSIT (10%): Total amount of Security deposit shall be limited to 10% of the awarded value of work. Fifty percent of this amount shall have to b e deposited as initial security deposit at the time of execution of agreement including the amount deposited as Earnest Money. In addition to the above, further amount to the extent of the 5% of awarded value of the work will be deducted from the Running Acc ount bills by way of percentage deductions. Such percentage deduction shall be @ 10% of the running account bills till the full am ount of security deposit is realized/ retained by the Corporation. (OR) Total security deposit amount can also be submitted to the c orporation in the form of bank guarantee profrom is attached 2. Return of 10% Security Deposit The remaining 50% security deposit shall be refunded to the Contractor on the Engineer-in-charge certifying in writing after completing the work s

uccessfully with all respects as per tender terms and conditions. The security deposit of 50% shall be refunded to the Contractor on the Engineer-in -charge certifying in writing submission of final bill. BANK GUARANTEE:- Wherever stipulated should be as per our proforma & issued by “Nationalized Bank/Scheduled Commercial Ban k”. All bank charges to be borne by bidder. Bank Guarantee should be automatically extended for validity period in the event of del ay in execution of contract 3. PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA: A) Experience Criteria Experience of having successfully completed similar jobs during last 07 years ending with the last date of the month preceding to the m onth in which the tender is floated for which bidders should meet in either (a or b or c) of the following:- Similar works means “Civil construction / repair/ maintenance works” a) One similar work costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.36.67 Lakhs. or b) Two similar works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 22.92Lakhs. or c) Three similar works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 18.33 Lakhs. Copy of completion/performance report from the organization where the relevant work is executed is to be enclosed. Submission of Work Order c opy alone is not adequate. Work completion certificate along with the work Order copy is to be submitted/ uploaded for consideration/ fulfillment. B) Financial Criteria Bidder must have achieved an average minimum financial turnover of Rs. 14.00 Lakhs or more during last three financial years ending on 31.03.20 25 (i.e., FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24& FY 2024-25) including Profit & Loss A/c statements (for FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24& FY 2024-25), audited balance sh eets with UDIN provided by the auditor, necessary undertaking (if any) etc. along with technical bid. Note1: No Exemption has been given from submission of copies of previous orders along with completion certificate & financial crit eria to any of MSME/NSIC bidders. All the bidders must submit the credentials to fulfill the mentioned Pre-Qualification criteria. Bid ders who are failing submission of copies of previous orders along with completion certificate & financial criteria there will be rejec ted 4. SCOPE OF WORK: A. The scope of work of this tender will be “Repair works at intake well, Intermediate pumping station at Parnapalle of Tummalapalle and other associated miscellaneous works” as per drawings and direction of Engineer-in-charge. Execution of:- 1. Channelling the surface runoff away from foundations, preventing erosion and dampness in walls/MCC 2. Repair of windows and replacements of broken glass in the MCC room and control area are old. 3. Repair of cracks/ honeycombs in well walls/ lining using suitable cementitious grouting or epoxy. 4. Separate room for storage of Mechanical, electrical and Civil materials. 5. Repairs to pump house, MCC rooms (Roof, flooring, plastering and painting). Note: Contractors are advised to see the area to get acquainted with the actual features of the area where the work is to be executed and g et other related information before quoting their rates for carrying out the work successfully. Bidders are requested to quote their rates ac cordingly. No any extra claim shall be entertained by UCIL for this work. Apart from the above the following jobs are also included as stated below:- a. Cutting of grasses in the working area and disposal within 2.00 K.M. b. The scope of work also includes the following for which no extra payment will be made. Therefore, contractor may consider this while q uoting their rate of other items as mentioned under bill of quantities for various items of work. c. Depute representative at the time of taking levels by UCIL’s representative before start the work with their own survey equipment’s or with equipment arranged by contractor as per direction of EIC. (Note :- In case contractor fails to depute their representative at the tim e of taking level, before start of the work, UCIL Representative shall take and record the level which has to be accepted by the contractor and no further claim shall be entertained in this regard. d. All transport vehicles, tool/tackles and safety equipment’s shall be arrange by the contractor. e. Detailed plan of action/Planning shall be submitted by executing agency in appropriate way before start of work. f. No excavation or usage shall be permitted within UCIL premises for use of any materials. g. Before installing/executing any materials list of items to be approved by Engineer In charge. h. Proper documentation such as drawings, Invoices, test reports, QAP etc. shall be maintained by agency at site office. The contractor sha

ll be furnished, free of charge, two certified copy of contract documents. i. COMPACTION: Base and all fillings material must be compacted properly by using road roller/Vibrating roller. j. All auxiliary/ preparatory works associated to the main tendered works like temporary road for transport of material, construction of go down, cleaning of drains etc. are in the scope of bidder only. UCIL will not provide any resources or support to complete the auxiliary/ pr eparatory works. No separate payment will be paid tot eh contractor for this auxiliary/ preparatory works by UCIL. k. Any equipment, material or services which are not mentioned in the tender document but required for completion of the work in safe an d efficient manner shall be deemed to be included. l. The Contractor shall carry out and complete the said work in every respect in accordance with the Contract and with the direction of an d to the satisfaction of the Corporation. The Corporation may in his absolute discretion and from time to time issue further drawings an d /or written instructions, details, directions and explanations, which are hereafter collectively referred to as UCIL’s instructions in regar d to: i. The variation or modification of the quantity of works or the addition or omission or substitution of any work well wit hin the value of the order has to be obeyed and accepted by the bidder. ii. Any discrepancy in the Drawings or between the Schedule of Quantities and/or Drawings and /or Specifications has t o be obeyed and accepted by the bidder. iii. The removal from the site of any material brought there on by the Contractor and the substitution of any other mater ial thereof. iv. The removal and/or re-execution of any works executed by the Contractor. v. The dismissal of any person from works employed there upon. vi. Opening up for inspection of any work covered up. vii. Amending & making good of any defect of work up to two years from the date of completion of work. So bank guarant ee will be force to valid up to performance guarantee period and claim period. Note-1: The proposal manpower will be issued RFID cards to enable them for entry to working areas at Tummalapalle plant area RFID cards should b e kept in the custody of each employee of contractor. At the end of awarded work, RFID cards should be returned back to UCIL in working condition. In case of loss of RFID cards or damage of RFID, an amount will be recovered from contractor’s bill. Contractor should consider the above at the time of submission of bid. In case of loss of RFID cards, the loss of cards should be reported to nearest police station and a copy of FIR to be obtained. For obtainin g new cards, copy of FIR and an amount of Rs. 2000/- or prevailing amount as notified by UCIL to be deposited along with an application by the contractor. Electrical scope: Contractor has to follows as per electricity act 2003 & CEAR regulations 2010 while constructing the building. Contract agency has to strictly adhere to schedule of quantities. FREEISSUE MATERIALS: - No material will be issued from UCIL. SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT 5. COMPENSATION FOR DELAY (PENALTY) If the Contractor fails to maintain the required progress in terms of the condition of this contract or to complete the work and clear the site on or be fore the contract or extended date/period of completion, he shall, without prejudice to any other right or remedy of the Corporation on account of s uch breach, pay as agreed compensation amount calculated as stipulated below or such similar amount as the contract value of the work for every week that the progress remains below that specified or that the work remain incomplete. This will also apply to items or group of items for which separate period of completion has been specified. For this purpose the terms ‘Contract Value’ shall be the value at contract rates of the works as ordered (a) Completion period (as originally stipulated) : @ 0.5 per cent per week up to a maximum of 10% of work order value. And contractor will be allowed to take up the pending jobs after submitting a request letter explaining the reasons for the delay and approval of EIC - within a maxi mum of 12 months from the date of the completion of actual order tenure. 6. Special instructions to bidders on penalty: Penalty will not applicable on Sundays and paid holidays. 7. However, the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central) and UCIL circulars, or any kind of circulars, the bidder should follow and accept circular terms and conditions.

8. TIME OF COMPLETION: Duration of job is for a period of 06 (Six) months from the date of actual commencement. Date of commencement within 10-30 days from date of issue of wor k order (or) as desired by UCIL engineer-in-charge. however the actual date of commencement shall be fixed by UCIL as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge. 9. DEFECT LIABILITY PERIOD: Nil 10. The Contractor shall be responsible to make good and remedy at his own expense within such period as may be stipulated by the Engineer-in-charge, any defe ct which may develop or may be noticed before the expiry of the period mentioned in Schedule – F hereto from the certified date of completion and intimation of which has been sent to the Contractor within seven days of the expiry of the s aid period by a letter sent by hand delivery or by registered post. 11. VARIATION IN QUANTITY OF ITEMS: The quantity mentioned under the “schedule of item (s)” of this tender is tentative. The actual quantity may vary from that indicated in the tender document due to actual conditions of the site or due to other reasons. The contractor shall carry out all additi onal work up to the total variation of ± 10 % of the awarded value. The other terms & conditions and rates shall remain firm within this limit. 12. EXTENSION: Completion period of contract is 06 (Six) months from the date of commencement. The tenure/period may be extended up to 03(Th ree) months (if the contract value is not consumed completely due to unforeseen reasons) further after completion of initial contract period with s ame rate, terms & conditions of the contract with mutual consent, if so deemed fit by UCIL and agreed by the contractor, as the nature of awarded work is as and when required basis and at discretion of the Engineer-in-charge. 1. The contractor shall pay to labour employed by him wages not less than fair wages as defined in the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act 1970 and rules made there under. Contractor should include for prevision of leave with wages for the workmen deployed in this contract accordi ng to the circular No. UCIL/DGM(P&IRS)/GEN/2024,dated: 07/09/2024.Bidder should quoted their rates with above prevision. i. It is to inform that the leave with wages are statutory provision under the mines Act 1952 and factory Act 1948. ii. It is hereby requested to include the suitable clauses and provision for the leave with wages in all the upcoming contracts including item based contracts strictly as per the applicable Act. iii. The amount will be reimbursed to the contractor for all manpower based contract on actual payment. 13. ESCALATION: No escalation will be paid this work. 14. EMD: Tenders received without earnest money deposit shall be summarily rejected. Copy of EMD shall be uploaded on tender portal. 15. Tender Fee: Not applicable Nil as per GeM guidelines 16. No Exemption EMD: The proposal job under works category, there is no any exemption given to any of MSME/NSIC bidders. 17. All participated bidders must submit EMD before the opening Technical part. Therefore bidders have not submitted EMD soft copy shall render the bi d liable for rejection. 18. Special note on Common IP addresses and common company address while evaluating bids: i. Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and showing the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the bidders(s)/ Seller (s).The receiv ed bids having matching/common IP address with either bidders(s)/ Seller(s) or buyer, shall be out rightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation. ii. Bidders are hereby informed that instances where different company names utilize the same address proof matching among bidders parti cipated will be promptly rejected and excluded from further evaluation. 19. Indemnity: Contractor will fully indemnify the corporation against all responsibility, any costs or expenses (including legal costs on an indemnity basis) and Claims of contractor’s workmen in respect of personal injury or death or loss of, or damage to or interference with, any other propert y (whether real or personal), third party or to corporations’ personnel and properties. Contractor shall abide by all the necessary pr ovisions of various other Labour Laws/Acts viz. ESI/Bonus, Workmen’s Compensation, EPF and any other laws and rules ap

plicable, in this regard. If on account of noncompliance with the provisions of any laws, Corporation is called upon to make any payment to or in respect of his employees, the service provider shall fully reimburse to Corporation for all such paym ent and Corporation shall be free to make deductions on this account from the amount of Performance Security Deposit a nd retention money. 20. Special Note: i. Any failure by the vendor/contractor to supply/execute the contract as per tender terms and conditions may result i n black listing of respective vendor's /contractor for a period of 01 year for a period of minimum 01 year to maximum of 0 2 years. ii. Also UCIL has the right to short close the order within the tenure, if the awarded bidder doesn’t obey/ execute the o rder as per tender terms and conditions (or) found in deviating any statutory compliance, with a prior notice of 10-15 day s. iii. The eligibility will be decided strictly based on documents submitted at the time of receipt of tenders. No additional documents be allowed to be submitted after receipt of tenders but there is no bar to seek clarification or authentication o f submitted documents. However in case of poor response, with a view to increase the competition, admission of additiona l documents to meet the PQ-Criteria may be allowed subject to the condition that a. "Poor response" implies when less than three bids are found suitable on the basis of submitted eligible documents as per NIT. b. The additional documents should not be issued subsequent to last date of receipt of tender as mentioned in the NI T c. The bidder submitting additional documents has submitted EMD and tender cost as prescribed in NIT. The opportunity of submission of additional documents be given to all the bidders. 21. Employees’ State Insurance (ESI): Employees’ State Insurance (ESI) contribution coverage under Employee’s Comp ensation Act, 1923. The rates of contribution as prescribed by the Government with specific notification on the date of floating of tender and subsequent changes if any as per Government N otification. All the workers deployed for this work to be ensured the payment of ESI and the documents to be submitted along with contractors’ bill without w hich bill will not be processed. Contractor must follow the latest guidelines of government in this regard and the guidelines issued by UCIL. In case the work center is situated, in an ESI non-implemented area / contract workers are drawing salary beyond the prescribed ceiling under ESI , it must be ensured that the contractor/ contracting firm should extend coverage to the contract workers through Employee Compensation Policy , to meet the Compensation Liability under Employee’s Compensation Act, 1923 along with Medical Liability. 22. EPF & Bonus Payment: EPF and Bonus payment to be done by the Contractor to their worker as per the Government rule. 23. Labour License: If applicable, necessary Labour License shall be obtained by the contractor for the workman engaged at site at his own cost which shall be reimb ursable on submission of documentary evidence. The Labour License shall be required to be obtained for the whole period of the contract and sha ll be furnished to the corporation before commencement of the work. ======= ======= . 4.
